```{=html}
<style>

<div id="app">
  <div id="view">
    <div id="readout"></div>
    <div id="note">orbits: <i>ρ</i><sub>L</sub> = 0.05 <i>L R</i><sub>E</sub> (p<sup>+</sup>), <i>m</i><sub>p</sub>/<i>m</i><sub>e</sub> = 16,<br><i>v</i><sub>g</sub>/(<i>v</i><sub>∇<i>B</i></sub> + <i>v</i><sub>c</sub>) as in the table (≤ 3), <b><i>g</i></b><sub>⊥</sub> only</div>
    <div id="src">Chen, Introduction to Plasma Physics (2016), Eqs. (2.18), (2.30); dipole equator: ∇<i>B</i>/<i>B</i> = 3/<i>r</i>, <i>R</i><sub>c</sub> = <i>r</i>/3, <i>B</i><sub>E</sub> = 3.1×10<sup>−5</sup> T</div>

    <button id="play" title="play/pause">❚❚</button><button id="reset" title="reset">↺</button>
  </div>
</div>
<script type="importmap">
{"imports": {"three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js",
             "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/"}}
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from "three";
import {OrbitControls} from "three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js";

// physics-begin
// Normalised units: lengths in R_E, B in B_E, so the equatorial field is 1/L³
// and the gyrofrequency is κB with κ = q B_E t₀/m (proton κ = 1, electron −16).
// Dipole moment along −z (geographic south): B = [3(m·r)r − m r²]/r⁵.
function dipole(x, y, z, out) {
  const r2 = x * x + y * y + z * z, r5 = r2 * r2 * Math.sqrt(r2), mr = -z;
  out[0] = 3 * mr * x / r5; out[1] = 3 * mr * y / r5; out[2] = (3 * mr * z + r2) / r5;
  return out;
}
// Boris step for dv/dt = κ v × B + a⊥ with gravity a = −G r̂/r². Only the
// part of a across B is kept: it alone drives the drift, while the parallel
// part would pull the scaled cold orbits into the Earth.
function borisStep(p, dt, B) {
  const [x, y, z] = p.x, r2 = x * x + y * y + z * z, r = Math.sqrt(r2);
  dipole(x, y, z, B);
  const g = -p.G / (r2 * r), B2 = B[0] * B[0] + B[1] * B[1] + B[2] * B[2];
  const gb = g * (x * B[0] + y * B[1] + z * B[2]) / B2;
  const ax = g * x - gb * B[0], ay = g * y - gb * B[1], az = g * z - gb * B[2];
  const h = 0.5 * dt;
  let vx = p.v[0] + h * ax, vy = p.v[1] + h * ay, vz = p.v[2] + h * az;
  const tx = p.kappa * B[0] * h, ty = p.kappa * B[1] * h, tz = p.kappa * B[2] * h;
  const s = 2 / (1 + tx * tx + ty * ty + tz * tz);
  const px = vx + vy * tz - vz * ty, py = vy + vz * tx - vx * tz, pz = vz + vx * ty - vy * tx;
  vx += s * (py * tz - pz * ty); vy += s * (pz * tx - px * tz); vz += s * (px * ty - py * tx);
  vx += h * ax; vy += h * ay; vz += h * az;
  p.v[0] = vx; p.v[1] = vy; p.v[2] = vz;
  p.x[0] += vx * dt; p.x[1] += vy * dt; p.x[2] += vz * dt;
}
// Particle with guiding centre at (L, 0, 0), speed v, equatorial pitch angle α.
function launch(kappa, L, v, alpha, G) {
  const b = 1 / L ** 3, vperp = v * Math.sin(alpha), vpar = v * Math.cos(alpha);
  // r = R + b̂ × v/ω_c with b̂ = ẑ and v⊥ along ŷ.
  return {kappa, G, x: [L - vperp / (kappa * b), 0, 0], v: [0, vperp, vpar], lost: false};
}
// Advance by time T with about 20 steps per local gyroperiod.
function advance(p, T, B, maxSteps = 40000) {
  let t = 0, n = 0;
  while (t < T && n < maxSteps && !p.lost) {
    const Bm = Math.hypot(...dipole(p.x[0], p.x[1], p.x[2], B));
    const dt = Math.min(2 * Math.PI / (20 * Math.abs(p.kappa) * Bm), T - t);
    borisStep(p, dt, B);
    t += dt; n++;
    if (Math.hypot(p.x[0], p.x[1], p.x[2]) < 1) p.lost = true;
  }
  return n;
}
// Guiding centre R = r − b̂ × v/ω_c.
function guidingCentre(p, B) {
  const [bx, by, bz] = dipole(p.x[0], p.x[1], p.x[2], B), Bm = Math.hypot(bx, by, bz);
  const w = p.kappa * Bm * Bm, [vx, vy, vz] = p.v;
  return [p.x[0] - (by * vz - bz * vy) / w, p.x[1] - (bz * vx - bx * vz) / w, p.x[2] - (bx * vy - by * vx) / w];
}
// SI drifts at the equator, r = L R_E, from v_D = F × B/(qB²) (Chen Eqs. 2.18, 2.30)
// with ∇B/B = 3/r and R_c = r/3; relativistic momentum for MeV electrons.
const SI = {e: 1.602176634e-19, c: 299792458, RE: 6.371e6, BE: 3.1e-5, g0: 9.81,
  m: {ion: 1.67262192e-27, ele: 9.1093837e-31}};
function drifts(species, L, WeV, alpha) {
  const m = SI.m[species], W = WeV * SI.e, B = SI.BE / L ** 3, r = L * SI.RE, g = SI.g0 / L ** 2;
  const gamma = 1 + W / (m * SI.c ** 2), v = SI.c * Math.sqrt(1 - 1 / gamma ** 2), p = gamma * m * v;
  const s2 = Math.sin(alpha) ** 2, c2 = Math.cos(alpha) ** 2;
  const vgradB = 3 * p * v * s2 / (2 * SI.e * B * r);
  const vcurv = 3 * p * v * c2 / (SI.e * B * r);
  const vg = gamma * m * g / (SI.e * B);
  const Wx = m * g * r / (3 * (1 + c2)) / SI.e;
  return {vgradB, vcurv, vg, ratio: vg / (vgradB + vcurv), Wx, rho: p * Math.sin(alpha) / (SI.e * B), B, g};
}
// physics-end

const ink = "#17202A", ionC = "#B55000", eleC = "#0072B2", grey = "#8A96A3";
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const view = $("view");
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
renderer.setClearColor(0xffffff, 1);
view.prepend(renderer.domElement);
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32, 1, 0.05, 200);
camera.position.set(9, 6.5, 15);
const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.enablePan = false;
controls.minDistance = 4; controls.maxDistance = 45;
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.75));
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
sun.position.set(5, 6, 8); scene.add(sun);

// Physics (x, y, z) with z north → three.js (x, z, −y), a proper rotation.
const T = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, z, -y);
const lineMat = (color, opacity = 1) => new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color, transparent: opacity < 1, opacity});
const polyline = (pts, mat) => new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts), mat);

// Earth with a few meridians and latitude circles.
scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 64, 32),
  new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({color: 0x9DC3E6, shininess: 10})));
const grat = lineMat(0x5D6D7E, 0.35);
for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
  const ph = k * Math.PI / 6, pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 64; i++) { const th = i * Math.PI / 32;
    pts.push(T(1.002 * Math.sin(th) * Math.cos(ph), 1.002 * Math.sin(th) * Math.sin(ph), 1.002 * Math.cos(th))); }
  scene.add(polyline(pts, grat));
}
for (const lat of [-60, -30, 30, 60]) {
  const pts = [], c = Math.cos(lat * Math.PI / 180), s = Math.sin(lat * Math.PI / 180);
  for (let i = 0; i <= 96; i++) { const ph = i * 2 * Math.PI / 96; pts.push(T(1.002 * c * Math.cos(ph), 1.002 * c * Math.sin(ph), 1.002 * s)); }
  scene.add(polyline(pts, grat));
}
// Equatorial plane with circles r = 2, 4, 6 R_E.
const plane = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(1, 6.6, 96),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xEEF1F4, transparent: true, opacity: 0.45, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false}));
plane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; scene.add(plane);
for (const rr of [2, 4, 6]) {
  const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 128; i++) { const ph = i * 2 * Math.PI / 128; pts.push(T(rr * Math.cos(ph), rr * Math.sin(ph), 0)); }
  scene.add(polyline(pts, lineMat(grey, 0.5)));
}
// Dipole field lines r = L cos²λ in four meridian planes.
const fl = lineMat(0x5D6D7E, 0.55);
for (const Lf of [2, 3.5, 5]) for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
  const ph = k * Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI / 4, pts = [], lmax = Math.acos(Math.sqrt(1 / Lf));
  for (let i = 0; i <= 80; i++) { const lam = -lmax + 2 * lmax * i / 80, r = Lf * Math.cos(lam) ** 2;
    pts.push(T(r * Math.cos(lam) * Math.cos(ph), r * Math.cos(lam) * Math.sin(ph), r * Math.sin(lam))); }
  scene.add(polyline(pts, fl));
}
// L-shell at the chosen L: surface of revolution about the dipole axis.
let shell = null;
function makeShell(L) {
  if (shell) { scene.remove(shell); shell.traverse((o) => o.geometry && o.geometry.dispose()); }
  const lmax = Math.acos(Math.sqrt(1 / L)), prof = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 60; i++) { const lam = -lmax + 2 * lmax * i / 60, r = L * Math.cos(lam) ** 2;
    prof.push(new THREE.Vector2(r * Math.cos(lam), r * Math.sin(lam))); }
  shell = new THREE.Group();
  shell.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.LatheGeometry(prof, 96),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0x0072B2, transparent: true, opacity: 0.06, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false})));
  const ring = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 128; i++) { const ph = i * 2 * Math.PI / 128; ring.push(T(L * Math.cos(ph), L * Math.sin(ph), 0)); }
  shell.add(polyline(ring, lineMat(0x0072B2, 0.6)));
  scene.add(shell);
}
// East arrow on the equator (φ̂ at φ = −90°) and B at the equator (northward).
const arrow = (dir, origin, len, color) => new THREE.ArrowHelper(dir.clone().normalize(), origin, len, color, 0.22 * len, 0.1 * len);
scene.add(arrow(T(1, 0, 0), T(-0.9, -6.3, 0), 1.8, 0x17202A));
scene.add(arrow(T(0, 0, 1), T(-5, 0, -0.8), 1.6, 0x5D6D7E));

// HTML labels at 3D points.
const labels = [];
function label(html, pos, cls = "") {
  const el = document.createElement("div"); el.className = "lbl " + cls; el.innerHTML = html;
  view.appendChild(el); labels.push({el, pos}); return el;
}
label("N", T(0, 0, 1.25)); label("S", T(0, 0, -1.25));
label("east", T(0.0, -6.75, 0)); label("<b><i>B</i></b>", T(-5, 0, 1.1));
label("<i>m̂</i>", T(0, 0, -2.2));
scene.add(arrow(T(0, 0, -1), T(0, 0, -1.05), 0.9, 0x5D6D7E));
function placeLabels() {
  const w = view.clientWidth, h = view.clientHeight;
  for (const {el, pos} of labels) {
    const p = pos.clone().project(camera);
    el.style.left = `${(p.x + 1) / 2 * w}px`; el.style.top = `${(1 - p.y) / 2 * h}px`;
    el.style.display = p.z < 1 ? "" : "none";
  }
}

// Trails: full orbit (recent part) and guiding centre.
function trail(color, n, opacity) {
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry(), arr = new Float32Array(3 * n);
  geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3)); geo.setDrawRange(0, 0);
  const line = new THREE.Line(geo, lineMat(color, opacity)); line.frustumCulled = false; scene.add(line);
  return {line, arr, n, count: 0,
    push(x, y, z) {
      if (this.count === this.n) { const keep = this.n >> 1; this.arr.copyWithin(0, 3 * (this.n - keep)); this.count = keep; }
      const i = 3 * this.count; this.arr[i] = x; this.arr[i + 1] = z; this.arr[i + 2] = -y; this.count++;
    },
    clear() { this.count = 0; this.sync(); },
    sync() { this.line.geometry.setDrawRange(0, this.count); this.line.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true; }};
}
const species = {
  ion: {kappa: 1, color: ionC, mass: 1, orbit: trail(ionC, 20000, 0.55), gc: trail(ionC, 6000, 1)},
  ele: {kappa: -16, color: eleC, mass: 1 / 16, orbit: trail(eleC, 20000, 0.45), gc: trail(eleC, 6000, 1)},
};
for (const s of Object.values(species)) {
  s.dot = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.07, 16, 8), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: s.color}));
  scene.add(s.dot);
}

const state = {playing: true};
const Bbuf = [0, 0, 0];
function params() {
  return {L: +$("L").value, W: 10 ** +$("W").value, alpha: +$("pitch").value * Math.PI / 180, which: $("species").value};
}
// Sim gravity G: equatorial v_g/(v_∇B + v_c) as in SI at the chosen W, capped at 3.
function gravity(name, P, v) {
  const ratio = Math.min(drifts(name, P.L, P.W, P.alpha).ratio, 3);
  return ratio * 1.5 * v * v * (1 + Math.cos(P.alpha) ** 2) * P.L;
}
function speed(name, L) { return (0.05 / L ** 2) / Math.sqrt(species[name].mass); }
function reset() {
  const P = params();
  makeShell(P.L);
  for (const [name, s] of Object.entries(species)) {
    const v = speed(name, P.L);
    s.p = launch(s.kappa, P.L, v, P.alpha, gravity(name, P, v));
    s.on = P.which === "both" || P.which === name;
    s.orbit.clear(); s.gc.clear();
    s.orbit.line.visible = s.gc.line.visible = s.dot.visible = s.on;
  }
  updateReadout();
}
const sup = (n) => String(n).replace("-", "−");
function fmt(x, unit) {
  if (!isFinite(x)) return "–";
  const e = Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.abs(x)) + 1e-9);
  if (e >= -2 && e <= 3) return `${+x.toPrecision(2)} ${unit}`;
  const m = x / 10 ** e;
  return `${m.toFixed(1)}×10<sup>${sup(e)}</sup> ${unit}`;
}
function fmtE(eV) {
  const u = [[1e6, "MeV"], [1e3, "keV"], [1, "eV"], [1e-3, "meV"], [1e-6, "µeV"]].find(([f]) => eV >= f * 0.9995) ?? [1e-6, "µeV"];
  const x = eV / u[0];
  return `${x >= 100 ? x.toFixed(0) : x >= 10 ? x.toFixed(1) : x.toFixed(2)} ${u[1]}`;
}
function updateReadout() {
  const P = params();
  $("Lo").textContent = P.L.toFixed(1);
  $("Wo").textContent = fmtE(P.W);
  $("po").textContent = `${Math.round(P.alpha * 180 / Math.PI)}°`;
  const d = {ion: drifts("ion", P.L, P.W, P.alpha), ele: drifts("ele", P.L, P.W, P.alpha)};
  // Direction for ions (q > 0): gravity east, ∇B and curvature west; electrons opposite.
  const dir = (name, east) => ((name === "ion") === east ? "E" : "W");
  const row = (lbl, f, east) => `<tr><td>${lbl}</td>${["ion", "ele"].map((n) =>
    `<td>${fmt(f(d[n]), "m/s")} ${east === null ? "" : dir(n, east)}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`;
  const net = (n) => { const x = d[n].vg - d[n].vgradB - d[n].vcurv; return (x > 0) === (n === "ion") ? "E" : "W"; };
  $("readout").innerHTML = `<table>
    <tr class="h"><td><i>B</i> = ${fmt(d.ion.B * 1e9, "nT")}, <i>g</i> = ${(d.ion.g).toFixed(2)} m/s²</td><td class="ion">p<sup>+</sup></td><td class="ele">e<sup>−</sup></td></tr>
    ${row("<i>v</i><sub>g</sub>", (x) => x.vg, true)}
    ${row("<i>v</i><sub>∇<i>B</i></sub>", (x) => x.vgradB, false)}
    ${row("<i>v</i><sub>c</sub>", (x) => x.vcurv, false)}
    <tr><td><i>v</i><sub>g</sub>/(<i>v</i><sub>∇<i>B</i></sub> + <i>v</i><sub>c</sub>)</td><td>${fmt(d.ion.ratio, "")}</td><td>${fmt(d.ele.ratio, "")}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>net drift</td><td>${net("ion")}</td><td>${net("ele")}</td></tr>
    <tr><td><i>W</i><sub>×</sub>: <i>v</i><sub>g</sub> = <i>v</i><sub>∇<i>B</i></sub> + <i>v</i><sub>c</sub></td><td>${fmtE(d.ion.Wx)}</td><td>${fmtE(d.ele.Wx)}</td></tr>
    <tr><td><i>ρ</i><sub>L</sub></td><td>${fmt(d.ion.rho, "m")}</td><td>${fmt(d.ele.rho, "m")}</td></tr>
  </table>`;
  // Energy changes only the scaled gravity of the running orbits.
  for (const [name, s] of Object.entries(species)) if (s.p) s.p.G = gravity(name, P, speed(name, P.L));
}

$("L").addEventListener("input", reset);
$("pitch").addEventListener("input", reset);
$("species").addEventListener("change", reset);
$("W").addEventListener("input", updateReadout);
$("reset").addEventListener("click", reset);
$("play").addEventListener("click", () => { state.playing = !state.playing; $("play").textContent = state.playing ? "❚❚" : "▶"; });

function resize() {
  const w = view.clientWidth, h = view.clientHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false); camera.aspect = w / h;
  // Portrait (phone): widen the view so the whole scene stays in frame.
  camera.fov = Math.min(70, 32 * Math.max(1, 1.5 / camera.aspect)); camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(view);
resize();
reset();

function frame() {
  const L = +$("L").value;
  if (state.playing) {
    // 0.25 equatorial proton gyroperiods per frame, cut into 8 sub-intervals for the trails.
    const Tf = 0.25 * 2 * Math.PI * L ** 3;
    for (const s of Object.values(species)) {
      if (!s.on || s.p.lost) continue;
      const sub = s.kappa === 1 ? 4 : 40;
      for (let k = 0; k < sub; k++) { advance(s.p, Tf / sub, Bbuf); s.orbit.push(...s.p.x); }
      s.gc.push(...guidingCentre(s.p, Bbuf));
      s.orbit.sync(); s.gc.sync();
    }
  }
  for (const s of Object.values(species)) s.dot.position.copy(T(...s.p.x));
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  placeLabels();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
```
